fields.description: Issue includes investigative and editorial coverage alleging graft and collusion in Miami-area bankruptcy proceedings, naming a referee, receiver, and others connected with a Miami Beach gas company bankruptcy and related business dealings. Additional local commentary addresses city governance and enforcement (including criticism of handling of employee theft), a Chamber of Commerce traffic-safety campaign with a full-page safety message, and community features such as the newspaper’s “Most Attractive Working Girl” contest (Courthouse winner Mary Buckley). Regular columns and items cover Miami Beach development notes, social/news briefs, and sports/racing content including “Jockey Jimmy” track reports and advertisements.
